data.Q: Who swears to stop eating and drinking until Paul is killed?
data.A: Some Jews who form the plot

data.Q: Whom do the chief priests and elders plan to ask to bring Paul?
Before whom do the chief priests and elders ask the commander to bring Paul?
Why do the chief priests and elders say they want Paul brought?
data.A: To learn more about his case

data.Q: When do the more than forty men plan to kill Paul?
data.A: Before he reaches the priests and elders
data.wrong_answer: When he is before the Sanhedrin

data.Q: Whom do the more than forty men bind themselves to kill?
To whom do the more than forty men report their oath?
data.A: The chief priests and the elders
